method: Manual review of three focused post-fix browser captures

captures.finding: The tier priority editor is centered above a clear backdrop, retains the inherited four fields and actions, and no longer appears after the page content.
The entered value 37 remains after preview redraw; the inherited impact notice and confirmation action are visible inside the same centered modal.
At 390px the English modal fits the viewport, keeps all four fields readable, and exposes full-size Cancel and Confirm controls without horizontal overflow.

scope_limit: Local static design only; no production save, configuration write, API, encryption, database, or real admin behavior was tested.
